title: PMO - brazil
description:
Você quer fazer parte de uma empresa com propósito? Fazer acontecer inspirando o melhor das pessoas está no DNA da nossa gente.


Prezamos por pessoas que:

• Buscam comprometimento e excelência em suas entregas;

• Criam e disseminam um ambiente colaborativo, com espírito de equipe, onde a amizade é valorizada;

• Queiram atuar com profissionais de confiança;

• E acreditam que o respeito e a humildade são essenciais para o seu dia a dia aqui na Numen.


Se você se identifica com tudo isso e quer ser Numen, não perca a oportunidade de participar desse processo seletivo!


REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES


  • Experiência na construção e acompanhamento de KPIs de projetos e na elaboração de planos de comunicação.
  • Vivência em projetos de implementação e integração SAP.
  • Inglês avançado para interação com times multiculturais.


Diferencial:

  • Participação em projetos com responsabilidade sobre o processo de migração de dados e garantia de integridade entre sistemas.


RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES


  • Apoiar a rotina diária de gestão de projetos, garantindo o acompanhamento de cronogramas, escopo, riscos, orçamento e entregas.
  • Consolidar informações e status dos projetos, preparando relatórios executivos e painéis de controle (dashboards) com indicadores de desempenho (KPIs).
  • Dar suporte na comunicação entre as equipes do projeto, assegurando o alinhamento entre as partes envolvidas e a atualização das informações nos canais oficiais.
  • Acompanhar planos de ação e pendências, auxiliando os responsáveis no cumprimento dos prazos e metas estabelecidos.
  • Organizar reuniões de acompanhamento, registrando atas, decisões e pontos de atenção.
  • Contribuir para a padronização de processos e metodologias de gestão de projetos, promovendo boas práticas de governança.
  • Monitorar entregáveis e apoiar a preparação de auditorias ou revisões de qualidade.
  • Colaborar com as lideranças e PMs na identificação de riscos, oportunidades de melhoria e otimização dos processos de gestão.


INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS


  • Procuramos um(a) profissional com perfil dinâmico(a), flexível e colaborativo(a), que se sinta à vontade em um ambiente de múltiplos projetos e demandas simultâneas, mantendo foco em qualidade, entrega e parceria com o cliente.
  • Contratação efetiva por tempo indeterminado.
  • Atuação 100% Remota.


BENEFÍCIOS


  • Vale transporte
  • Vale Refeição
  • Vale Alimentação
  • Swile Shop
  • TotalPass
  • Vittude
  • Assistência Médica Sulamérica
  • Assistência Odonto Sulamérica
  • Auxílio-Creche
  • Benefício para filhos PCD
  • Previdência Privada
  • Numen School
  • Parcerias educacionais com FIA, FIAP, Moovi, Wise Up e English Pass.

title: Software Engineer Sênior - Vaga afirmativa para mulheres cis e trans
description:
A abertura atual é para a Artefact do Brasil, mas estamos em modelo Free Office.
Quem nós somos

Nós da Artefact Brasil acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact !
Quais serão suas atividades;
Como Software Engineer Sênior na Artefact, você será uma peça-chave do nosso time de tecnologia, contribuindo ativamente para o desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações web complexas que apoiam nossos projetos de dados e insights em múltiplas indústrias.
Você atuará em colaboração com equipes de Data Engineering, Data Science e Consultoria Analítica, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e integradas às necessidades reais dos nossos clientes. Além de desenvolver, você será referência técnica, ajudando a definir padrões e boas práticas dentro da equipe.    
Suas principais responsabilidades incluirão:  

  • Liderar o desenvolvimento de aplicações web utilizando JavaScript/TypeScript e frameworks modernos como React e Next.js , priorizando arquitetura limpa, reuso e performance. 
  • Projetar e implementar soluções de integração de dados com bancos relacionais e não relacionais (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Azure Cosmos DB) , com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade.  
  • Gerenciar e otimizar aplicações na nuvem , configurando autenticação, segurança e deploys contínuos em múltiplos provedores cloud, como Azure, GCP e AWS.      
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinar :  transformando modelos e algoritmos de dados em soluções visuais e produtos interativos.      
  • Definir arquitetura de software e padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas de DevOps, CI/CD , testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores de diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração.  
  • Contribuir estrategicamente para decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções.


O que nós estamos procurando;    

  • Formação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou curso na área correlata.      
  • Experiência solida (+5 anos):  em desenvolvimento web com React, Next.js, JavaScript e TypeScript.     
  • Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL , com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance.      
  • Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) , incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.
  • Experiência prática com DevOps e CI/CD , uso de Docker , Kubernetes e ferramentas de integração contínua.
  • Visão arquitetural e capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas.  
  • Inglês fluente (para interação com equipes e clientes internacionais).


O que oferecemos;       

  • VR/VT       
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)       
  • Gympass       
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico       
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!)       
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)      
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)       

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós;       

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da tecnologia de dados       
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender       
  • Cultura: junte-se à melhor equipe que você poderia imaginar       
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!       

Junte-se a nós!

title: Trilingual Technical Support Analyst
description:
InvGate is a fast growing SaaS company that develops products for IT management and service automation, used by clients in over 60 countries in industries such as banking, e-commerce, education and technology.


To support our continuous growth we are looking for a Trilingual Technical Support Analyst to join our team.


Some of the role's responsibilities include providing technical and functional support to clients worldwide through different channels such as email, tickets, and remote sessions (Teamviewer/Zoom/etc), checking clients' configurations, suggesting improvements and best practices to maximize the platform's efficiency, and working closely with the development and customer success teams to troubleshoot issues.


Do not hesitate to apply if you…


  • are fluent in English, Spanish and Portuguese (native-level portuguese strongly preffered, C1 level is the minimum required)
  • enjoy working with clients, providing top-level support
  • think analytically
  • have strong communication and troubleshooting skills
  • have previous experience in technical support for software and/or infrastructure
  • are tech-savvy


Having previous experience using InvGate products is a big plus!


We offer real opportunities for professional development, fully covered English classes, technical training both in-house and at educational centers, top-tier health insurance, a fixed amount for purchases in the food sector, reimbursement for remote work, and extended vacation and paternity leave.

Some of the role's responsibilities include providing technical and functional support to clients worldwide through different channels such as email, tickets, and remote sessions (Teamviewer/Zoom/etc), checking clients' configurations, suggesting improvements and best practices to maximize the platform's efficiency, and working closely with the development and customer success teams to troubleshoot issues.


Do not hesitate to apply if you…


  • are fluent in English, Spanish and Portuguese (native-level portuguese strongly preffered, C1 level is the minimum required)
  • enjoy working with clients, providing top-level support
  • think analytically
  • have strong communication and troubleshooting skills
  • have previous experience in technical support for software and/or infrastructure
  • are tech-savvy


Having previous experience using InvGate products is a big plus!


We offer real opportunities for professional development, fully covered English classes, technical training both in-house and at educational centers, top-tier health insurance, a fixed amount for purchases in the food sector, reimbursement for remote work, and extended vacation and paternity leave.

title: .NET UI Developer with Blazor Hybrid
description:
Hey, Dev, check the opportunity we have here at Brick Abode!


About Brick Abode


We are a software development company that serves clients from multiple countries around the world, with differing technological needs. Therefore, we value a good computer science base.


Contractors with a solid understanding of the basic building blocks of today’s technology are really welcome and thrive at Brick Abode.


People here are given autonomy, not put into a box to work only on one thing. They are in touch with the business needs of our clients, sometimes communicating with them directly.


We challenge ourselves to learn new things and go outside our comfort zone. Candidates who are up to the challenge will have an amazing career with us.


If you feel that your values fit with Brick Abode culture, check below for further details about this Position.


What kind of professional are we looking for?


We’re looking for a responsible and proactive professional who can navigate between technology and business contexts with ease, feel comfortable in fast-paced environments, and have great communication skills.

Our team is Brazil and USA-based, and communication is in English. The position is fully remote.



What do I need to have to apply for this position?


  • ASP.NET
  • .NET Core 9
  • Rich UI development in Blazor
  • Proven experience with Web development and the use of REST APIs
  • Working knowledge of Blazor Hybrid (WinForms Blazor)
  • Working knowledge of MVVM (Model-View-ViewModel) for better code separation and maintainability
  • Working knowledge of Secure applications using OAuth, JWT, and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
  • Advanced or Fluent English
  • An academic background (MSc or PhD) will also be a plus


This is an exciting new project where they are developing an innovative system to automate the client's process using robotics.



As Contractor (PJ), you will have:


  • Competitive compensation (in Reais - R$)
  • Work with international clients with international standards
  • Opportunity to grow as a leader
  • Possibility to move between teams
  • Speak in English with your coworkers
  • 2 weeks of paid leave per year
  • National holidays
  • Paid parental leave
  • Paid marriage leave
  • Working with a company that cares about our people and their personal growth
  • All expenses paid for training, conferences, and online courses
  • Remote work
  • Health Care Plan - Online


If you are passionate about technology and have a strong desire to work on cutting-edge projects, we encourage you to apply for this position!


Submit your CV to make sure it contains your LinkedIn and GitHub accounts.

Please submit your resume in English - we can only consider applications submitted in this language.

title: Ruby on Rails Developer
description:
About You

You are a back-end engineer passionate about building scalable, reliable, and maintainable applications. You thrive on writing clean code, applying modern architecture patterns, and leveraging cloud-based solutions. You enjoy solving complex challenges, automating infrastructure, and ensuring that systems are secure, performant, and ready to scale. You’re looking for a company where you can keep growing professionally and directly influence technical excellence.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field; or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in back-end development using Ruby on Rails.
  • Strong experience with AWS services such as Lambda, EC2, S3, RDS, and API Gateway.
  • Hands-on experience using Terraform for Infrastructure as Code (IaC) deployments.
  • Solid understanding of serverless architectures and AWS Lambda functions.
  • Experience designing and consuming RESTful and GraphQL APIs.
  • Knowledge of PostgreSQL, Redis, and background job frameworks (Sidekiq, Resque).
  • Familiarity with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and automated deployments.
  • Experience working with Agile/Scrum methodologies, and proficiency using Jira and Confluence for project tracking.
  • Strong debugging, problem-solving, and communication skills for cross-functional collaboration.
  • Experience with microservices, GoLang, or Node.js for complementary service integration (nice to have).


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain Ruby on Rails applications with a focus on scalability and performance.
  • Build and manage AWS infrastructure components using Terraform and DevOps best practices.
  • Implement and maintain serverless solutions leveraging AWS Lambda and related services.
  • Integrate and maintain APIs and external systems, ensuring reliability and data consistency.
  • Refactor legacy components to improve maintainability, performance, and code clarity.
  • Write and maintain automated tests (RSpec, Minitest) to ensure high code quality and coverage.
  • Monitor application performance and proactively address issues or bottlenecks.
  • Collaborate on CI/CD pipelines, ensuring secure, consistent, and efficient deployments.
  • Participate in code reviews, maintaining high-quality development standards.
  • Engage in Agile ceremonies (standups, sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives).
  • Work closely with front-end, DevOps, and QA teams to deliver robust, end-to-end solutions.


Additional Information

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.


Some of our perks and benefits:

  • Celebrations
  • Special discounts*
  • Entertainment area*
  • Modern Work Spaces*
  • Great work environment
  • Private medical insurance*


*Benefits may vary according to your location and/or availability. Request further information when applying.

title: Python Developer
description:
We are seeking a skilled Python Developer to design and implement RESTful APIs, preferably using Litestar. You will integrate with OpenAI APIs and similar third-party services, focusing on authentication, rate limits, retries, and streaming. Your role will involve building robust data ingestion pipelines, including web scraping, parsing, and normalization. You will write clean, maintainable code, participate in code reviews, and manage CI/CD processes. You will own features end-to-end, from scoping to deployment and monitoring.


Requirements:


  • Solid hands-on experience with Python;
  • Strong knowledge of HTTP/REST, JSON, authentication (JWT/OAuth), and API design
  • Experience with OpenAI APIs (or equivalent) and related tooling
  • Web scraping using requests/ BeautifulSoup/lxml, and Playwright/Selenium
  • Data parsing (regex, JSON/CSV), basic pandas
  • Proficiency in SQL (PostgreSQL or similar), ORMs (SQLAlchemy), and Docker
  • Familiarity with typing, linting, and formatting tools (ruff/black)
  • Clear communication skills, reliability, and the ability to manage your own work

Languages:

  • English

title: Senior Data Analyst
description:
We are a collective group of fearless people with a clear purpose: to empower professionals around the world through intelligent workflow automation software. Currently, more than 500 people across 7 countries work with us, remotely or in a hybrid way, to make life easier for over 3,000 companies using Pipefy in more than 180 countries. Since our founding in 2015, we have put people at the center of everything we do, so we invite you to learn more about this position and apply to be part of our team.


Job Description:


We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst with a focus on Business Intelligence, Analytics, and Insights. The ideal candidate will have solid experience in data analysis, with a strong understanding of tools such as SQL and Python. The primary goal is to be able to translate data into actionable insights, supporting strategic decision-making across different business areas such as Sales, Product, Customer Success, and Go-to-Market. Familiarity with data visualization tools (such as Tableau) is desirable.


The professional will be responsible for leading complex data analysis projects, presenting results, and collaborating with different stakeholders to enhance the company's data strategy. Experience in data storytelling is essential, ensuring that insights are communicated and documented clearly and effectively.


* It is important to note that this opportunity is not related to data engineering.


Responsibilities:


- Conduct advanced data analyses to generate insights into business performance, trends, and growth opportunities;

- Communicate insights and strategic recommendations through presentations and data narratives (data storytelling), facilitating decision-making processes;

- Collaborate with different business areas to understand needs and translate business questions into clear and objective data analyses;

- Share knowledge and experience with the entire Data team, fostering technical collaboration and helping to increase the department's data maturity.


Requirements:


- Experience in a data analysis role;

- Strong communication skills;

- Advanced SQL and proficiency in Python (Pandas, NumPy, Plotly, Scikit-learn);

- Apply quantitative techniques to generate business insights;

- Ability to work with cross-functional teams, especially Sales, Product, Customer Success, and Go-to-Market teams;

- Familiarity with data visualization tools (such as Tableau) is desirable.


Benefits:


- Health and Dental Plan

- Individual Life Insurance

- Flexible Hours (in compliance with daily work hours)

- Flexible Meal/Food Allowance

- Home Office Support

- Furniture Assistance

- Psychological Support (for you or legal dependents)

- Wellhub

- Extended Maternity and Paternity Leave

- School/Nanny Allowance

- Supplemental Nutrition Assistance

- Veterinary Plan

- Birthday Day Off

- Marriage Leave (7 days)

- Bereavement Leave for Loved Ones (10 days)

- Bereavement Leave for Adoption or Pet Loss (2 days)

- Individual Funeral Assistance

- Monthly Education Support

- Payroll Loan

- Financial Consulting

- Udemy Corporate Access

- Coworking Space

- Pipefy License for up to 10 Users

title: Full-Time Video AI Prompt Engineer
description:
About Us

Click Bait is a performance-focused creative team that builds direct-response videos for high-growth e-commerce brands. We move fast, test relentlessly, and obsess over outcomes. We’re expanding our AI production capability to scale Video Sales Letters (VSLs) and product ads at volume.


Role Overview

We’re hiring a Video AI Prompt Engineer to generate high-quality AI footage for VSLs and product ads using leading video AI platforms (e.g., Veo 3, Nanobana, Sora 2, or equivalents). You’ll collaborate closely with our creative strategist and editing team, translating concepts into effective prompts, maintaining scene cohesion, and delivering footage that slots neatly into polished, persuasive edits.


Key Responsibilities

  • Generate AI-powered video sequences for VSLs with clear narrative continuity and scene cohesion.
  • Produce compelling product renders and demo visuals that showcase real-world use.
  • Translate briefs/storyboards into precise prompts; iterate rapidly to hit creative and performance goals.
  • Partner with editors to refine pacing, shot selection, and transitions for final production.
  • Leverage AI tools for script-based storytelling, editing assists, and engagement optimization.
  • Proactively experiment with techniques and models to push quality, speed, and reliability.


Qualifications & Skills

  • Proven hands-on experience with Veo 3, Nanobana, Sora 2, or comparable top-tier video AI tools.
  • Strong artistic judgment and creative problem-solving; comfort with direct-response storytelling.
  • Demonstrated ability to maintain visual consistency across multi-shot sequences.
  • Practical video editing fluency (timing, rhythm, narrative arc) and workflow collaboration.
  • Bias to action, ownership mindset, and comfort working in a fast-paced production environment.
  • A portfolio or case studies that showcase relevant AI video work (VSLs, product demos, short-form DR ads).

title: Software Engineer
description:
Description

A Bubble Developer is responsible for designing, developing, and deploying scalable web applications on the Bubble platform, enabling rapid development without extensive coding. This role requires expertise in Bubble’s features, workflows, and plugins to deliver custom solutions tailored to client needs. The ideal candidate excels in written communication for asynchronous collaboration and demonstrates strong self-management and independent problem-solving skills, effectively working with project managers, designers, and developers to meet high standards and project timelines.

Responsibilities
  • Application Development

1.1. Design and develop fully functional web applications using the Bubble platform, ensuring alignment with client requirements, milestones, and business goals.

1.2. Configure workflows, database structures, and API integrations within Bubble to enable seamless functionality.

1.3. Create responsive designs that work across various devices, adhering to UX/UI best practices.

1.4. Utilize Bubble’s visual programming interface to implement features such as user authentication, data management, and third-party API integrations, with a foundational knowledge of Airdev Canvas (training provided in-house if needed).

1.5. Stay up to date with Bubble’s certification requirements to ensure ongoing expertise and alignment with the platform’s latest features and best practices.

2.Customization and Integration

2.1. Leverage Bubble’s plugin marketplace and external APIs to extend application functionality.

2.2. Develop custom workflows and logic to address complex client requirements.

2.3. Work with RESTful APIs and other integration points to enhance the app’s capabilities, ensuring scalability and performance.

3.Testing and Quality Assurance

3.1. Conduct thorough testing of applications to ensure smooth functionality and resolve any bugs or issues before delivery, providing evidence through test cases, such as videos of specific development milestones or flows, as part of the development QA process.

3.2. Collaborate with QA teams or Project Managers to troubleshoot and optimize applications, ensuring high-quality user experiences, and co-leading handoff calls to ensure a smooth transition to the client or next project phase.

4.Documentation

4.1. Maintain comprehensive documentation for each project, including a structured database schema and recorded test case videos to demonstrate key workflows and functionality.

4.2. Create detailed guides for client handoff to facilitate smooth transitions and enable clients to manage the application effectively.

4.3. Adhere to documentation standards to ensure consistency in internal knowledge sharing, supporting scalability and efficient onboarding of team members.

5.Collaboration

5.1. Work closely with project managers, UX/UI designers, and other developers to ensure that the application meets client expectations.

5.2. Participate in project kick-off meetings and client calls to provide input on technical feasibility and development timelines.

5.3. Communicate progress, challenges, and updates to the Project Manager and other stakeholders.

5.4. Mentor junior developers, providing guidance and support to foster their technical growth and integration within the development team.

Qualifications

Experience:

-2+ years of experience developing coded web applications, with at least 2 years of experience specifically on the Bubble platform.

-Strong understanding of Bubble’s database architecture, workflows, and plugin system.

-Experience with third-party API integrations, webhooks, and backend services, including 3rd party db's such as Xano or Supabase.

Skills:

-Expertise in building responsive web applications using Bubble’s interface.

-Solid understanding of web technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) and how they are applied in a low-code environment.

-Ability to solve complex problems and design efficient workflows within the Bubble ecosystem.

-Strong english communication skills to collaborate with cross-functional teams and present technical solutions to non-technical stakeholders.

Tools:

-Proficiency in Bubble.io platform and its various features, including database management, API connections, and plugin usage.

-Familiarity with tools like Figma, n8n, or other platforms that can integrate with Bubble for enhanced functionality.

title: Sales Executive JUNIOR (Fluent English) Remote / U.S. Market Sales Support
description:
Sales Executive JUNIOR (Fluent English) Remote / U.S. Market Sales Support


Na BlueDot BPO Solutions, conectamos talentos do Brasil e da América Latina a empresas globais de alto desempenho. Com mais de 10 anos de experiência em soluções de outsourcing e staff augmentation, atuamos no segmento B2B corporativo, fornecendo profissionais altamente qualificados para posições estratégicas em equipes internacionais. Esta oportunidade é voltada a profissionais com inglês fluente e sólida vivência no ambiente corporativo, que desejam integrar o time de uma empresa norte-americana, atuando de forma 100% remota e em colaboração direta com equipes dos Estados Unidos.


  • Remuneração mensal de R$4.000
  • Trabalho 100% Remoto, de Segunda à Sexta-feira (12h - 21h BRT)
  • Oportunidade de crescimento para funções Senior
  • Exposição internacional e networking com executivos dos EUA
  • Treinamento remunerado de 3 a 5 semanas com preparação para certificações internas (Altamente Desafiador)


What You'll Do

  • Apoiar o time de vendas outbound em campanhas de prospecção (e-mails, LinkedIn, ligações)
  • Qualificar leads B2B e manter o pipeline atualizado e organizado
  • Auxiliar na preparação de materiais e agendas de reuniões comerciais
  • Apoiar apresentações de propostas e acompanhar reuniões executivas
  • Conduzir pesquisas de mercado e identificar novas oportunidades e tendências
  • Manter registros e KPIs atualizados em ferramentas de CRM (Hubspot, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, etc)


What We're Looking For

  • 1-3 anos de experiência em Business Sales /Outbound reach, idealmente com mercado internacional
  • Inglês Fluente (C1+ level): nível de fluência e comunicação próximo ao Nível Fluente
  • Perfil Corporativo, familiarizado com tratativas de vendas B2B e ambiente corporativo
  • Perfil Multitasking, carismático, com comunicação clara e assertiva
  • Motivado por metas, resultados claros e que gosta de desempenho mensurável
  • Que esteja habituado a um Fast Paced environment bem como a um ambiente comercial direto, assertivo e focado em resultados


Nice to Have

  • Experiência com ferramentas com ferramentas de prospecção
  • Vivência com o mercado americano ou clientes internacionais
  • Histórico de suporte a processos de vendas B2B


Tech / Ambiente 

  • Equipamento adequado: computador robusto, internet de alta velocidade, headset com bom microfone
  • Ambiente tranquilo para vídeo-chamadas e reuniões externas
  • Preferencialmente 2 monitores


Candidate-se, apenas, caso atenda a todos os critérios da vaga e estiver disposto a crescer em um ambiente comercial internacional exigente e de alta performance.

title: Ruby on Rails Developer
description:
About You

You are a back-end engineer passionate about building scalable, reliable, and maintainable applications. You thrive on writing clean code, applying modern architecture patterns, and leveraging cloud-based solutions. You enjoy solving complex challenges, automating infrastructure, and ensuring that systems are secure, performant, and ready to scale. You’re looking for a company where you can keep growing professionally and directly influence technical excellence.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field; or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in back-end development using Ruby on Rails.
  • Strong experience with AWS services such as Lambda, EC2, S3, RDS, and API Gateway.
  • Hands-on experience using Terraform for Infrastructure as Code (IaC) deployments.
  • Solid understanding of serverless architectures and AWS Lambda functions.
  • Experience designing and consuming RESTful and GraphQL APIs.
  • Knowledge of PostgreSQL, Redis, and background job frameworks (Sidekiq, Resque).
  • Familiarity with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and automated deployments.
  • Experience working with Agile/Scrum methodologies, and proficiency using Jira and Confluence for project tracking.
  • Strong debugging, problem-solving, and communication skills for cross-functional collaboration.
  • Experience with microservices, GoLang, or Node.js for complementary service integration (nice to have).


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain Ruby on Rails applications with a focus on scalability and performance.
  • Build and manage AWS infrastructure components using Terraform and DevOps best practices.
  • Implement and maintain serverless solutions leveraging AWS Lambda and related services.
  • Integrate and maintain APIs and external systems, ensuring reliability and data consistency.
  • Refactor legacy components to improve maintainability, performance, and code clarity.
  • Write and maintain automated tests (RSpec, Minitest) to ensure high code quality and coverage.
  • Monitor application performance and proactively address issues or bottlenecks.
  • Collaborate on CI/CD pipelines, ensuring secure, consistent, and efficient deployments.
  • Participate in code reviews, maintaining high-quality development standards.
  • Engage in Agile ceremonies (standups, sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives).
  • Work closely with front-end, DevOps, and QA teams to deliver robust, end-to-end solutions.


Additional Information

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.


Some of our perks and benefits:

  • Celebrations
  • Special discounts*
  • Entertainment area*
  • Modern Work Spaces*
  • Great work environment
  • Private medical insurance*


*Benefits may vary according to your location and/or availability. Request further information when applying.

  • Experience designing and consuming RESTful and GraphQL APIs.

title: SDR (100% remote)
description:
Mandatory - to complete your application, please visit:


SDR - Lead with Precision and Confidence


Are you an assertive, self-confident, and analytic professional who thrives in high-urgency environments? We are looking for a serious, detail-oriented Sales Development Representative (SDR) to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for high-volume outbound prospecting, making calls, sending emails, and using LinkedIn to target facilities managers and maintenance decision-makers.


About WiseVAs

WiseVAs is a premium staffing agency specializing in connecting exceptional remote professionals with businesses seeking top-tier talent. We pride ourselves on our rigorous vetting process and ability to match clients with highly skilled virtual executives.


The Opportunity

As a SDR, you will take charge of outbound prospecting efforts, managing a pipeline of 200-250 daily activities. Your role will focus on making cold calls, navigating gatekeepers, and setting appointments for our closers. Success will be based on your ability to schedule high-quality appointments while managing a strategic outreach approach over a 3-4 month sales cycle.


You will be expected to handle objections professionally, follow a structured process, and ensure that all activities are tracked meticulously. If you are analytical, able to follow rules, and focus on precision and efficiency, we want you to join our team.


Your Responsibilities

  • Make cold calls to facilities managers, navigating gatekeepers and targeting key decision-makers.


  • Manage a high-volume pipeline, following up on leads and ensuring efficient scheduling of appointments.


  • Deliver brief and impactful value propositions to prospects.


  • Schedule appointments for the closing team and ensure timely follow-up on all activities.


  • Track all interactions and maintain organized records in the CRM system.


  • Handle objections in a professional manner, ensuring smooth and productive conversations.


  • Work 40 hours per week, meeting success metrics based on the volume and quality of appointments set.


Required Qualifications

  • Strong English communication skills, with a professional phone demeanor.


  • Previous experience in cold calling and appointment setting.


  • Proven ability to manage a high-volume pipeline and engage in back-and-forth dialogues with prospects.


  • Experience with CRM or tracking systems to manage leads effectively.


  • Reliability to commit to 40 hours per week.


  • No healthcare industry experience required (scripts will be provided).


This Role Is NOT For You If:

  • You are uncomfortable working in a high-urgency, fast-paced environment.


  • You prefer not to follow structured processes or workflows.


  • You struggle with multi-tasking and managing a large volume of leads.


Apply now:


This is an external position to work at a WiseVAs client. Considering that the management of job positions is entirely handled by the hiring companies, and that WiseVAs operates solely as an intermediary between the candidate and the hiring company, the submission of proposals by candidates does not guarantee employment. Similarly, candidates acknowledge and authorize the storage of resumes and proposals in WiseVAs's database, as well as the receipt of messages, emails, and calls offering new job positions and opportunities.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
About Ótmow

Ótmow is a fast-growing fintech startup reshaping financial access for companies that work with the Brazilian government. We empower these businesses with seamless, secure, and accessible financial solutions in order to provide essential government services with confidence.


About the Role

We’re looking for a Full Stack Software Engineer who treats AI as a partner, not just a tool. You’ll build end-to-end features across the stack while creatively leveraging AI to accelerate development, automate workflows, and design scalable, flexible systems.

You’ll work in a fast-moving environment focused on transforming complex data into intelligent products. From building a credit matrix and automating sales/marketing workflows to designing dashboards and public-data scrapers, you’ll directly shape Ótmow’s core technology.


Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain features using React (TypeScript) and Python (FastAPI or Flask) .
  • Collaborate with AI tools (GPT, Claude, Cursor, etc.) to speed up coding, automate tasks, and improve quality.
  • Design and execute web scraping jobs to extract structured data from public transparency portals.
  • Develop and integrate infrastructure on GCP (Cloud Run, Firestore, Firebase Auth) and Supabase (PostgreSQL) .
  • Implement product features such as credit matrices, automation tools, and performance dashboards.
  • Ensure data integrity and quality across systems.
  • Actively participate in architecture design, code reviews, and planning sessions.
  • Experiment with emerging AI models and evaluate their potential for development, automation, and decision support.


Required Skills

  • 2+ years of experience in full-stack development.
  • Strong proficiency with TypeScript and React .
  • Solid experience with Python and backend frameworks (FastAPI, Flask ).
  • Experience with web scraping (Playwright, BeautifulSoup, requests).
  • Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and version control (Git, CI/CD) .
  • Fluency in AI-assisted development tools such as GPT, Claude, Cursor, etc.
  • Ability to work independently and communicate clearly in a remote setup.
  • Advanced English (for documentation and discussions) and Native Portuguese (for technical and business communication).
  • Ability to work under Pessoa Jurídica (PJ) in Brazil.


Preferred Skills

  • Experience scraping dynamic websites or handling anti-bot systems.
  • Background in data-driven products or credit/fintech platforms.
  • Knowledge of AI APIs or model fine-tuning.
  • Experience automating developer workflows using AI tools.


Why Join Us?

You’ll be part of a company at the intersection of fintech, data, and AI , redefining how public-sector suppliers access credit in Brazil, to build impactful, scalable solutions. And more ...

  • Competitive salary + performance bonuses.
  • Potential for equity participation, sharing in Ótmow’s long-term success.
  • Opportunity to transform a traditional sector with cutting-edge fintech solutions.
  • Flexible hours and remote-friendly culture.
  • Join a collaborative, diverse global team where different backgrounds, perspectives, and ideas drive innovation.

  • Represent technical solutions and communicate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including executives.
  • Proactively identify risks and implement mitigation strategies in project planning and execution.

title: En español - Senior Full Stack Senior (Enfoque Backend)
description:
• Desarrollador/a Full Stack Senior (Enfoque Backend)
  • Remoto (preferencia zona horaria UTC-3 a UTC+2)
  • Jornada completa


Qué hacemos

Publica.la es una plataforma SaaS B2B utilizada por cientos de editoriales, librerías y bibliotecas en todo el mundo para gestionar y potenciar sus ventas de contenido digital.

Nuestra plataforma multi-tenant procesa millones de transacciones en 156 países , administrando bibliotecas digitales, suscripciones y e-commerce a gran escala.

Buscamos un Desarrollador/a Full Stack Senior con fuerte experiencia en backend para ayudarnos a construir y escalar los sistemas centrales que impulsan este crecimiento, trabajando con Laravel/PHP , SingleStore , arquitectura multi-tenant y sistemas distribuidos .

Qué harás
  • Diseñar y desarrollar nuevas funcionalidades para nuestra plataforma SaaS multi-tenant, con foco en los servicios backend.
  • Construir y mantener aplicaciones escalables en Laravel utilizando PHP , SingleStore y Valkey/Redis .
  • Trabajar con bases de datos SQL distribuidas (SingleStore) e implementar patrones eficientes de aislamiento de datos multi-tenant .
  • Desarrollar y optimizar procesos en background basados en colas para la ingesta de contenido, pagos y analítica.
  • Colaborar con desarrolladores frontend en la integración con Livewire y Alpine.js .
  • Garantizar la calidad del código mediante testing (PHPUnit/Pest ), análisis estático (PHPStan ) y revisiones de código.
  • Participar en decisiones de arquitectura y planificación técnica para la escalabilidad de la plataforma.
  • Trabajar directamente con clientes para entender sus necesidades y mejorar el producto.
  • Mantener y mejorar funcionalidades existentes, asegurando rendimiento y confiabilidad .
Nuestro stack tecnológico

Tecnologías: PHP con Laravel, Livewire, Alpine.js, TailwindCSS, Laravel Nova, Valkey/Redis

Infraestructura: SingleStore, AWS Lambda, AWS S3, Cloudflare Workers, Docker, GitLab CI/CD


Podrías encajar si tienes
  • Más de 6 años de experiencia en desarrollo Full Stack , con fuerte enfoque en backend.
  • Amplia experiencia en PHP y Laravel (mínimo 3 años trabajando con el framework).
  • Sólidos conocimientos de bases de datos SQL .
  • Experiencia construyendo y escalando aplicaciones SaaS multi-tenant .
  • Fuerte comprensión de arquitecturas basadas en colas y procesamiento en background.
  • Experiencia con frameworks de testing (PHPUnit/Pest) y herramientas de análisis estático .
  • Nivel nativo o conversacional de español , y buenas habilidades de comunicación escrita en inglés y español (la mayoría de la comunicación es asincrónica y escrita).
  • Mentalidad proactiva y capacidad para trabajar eficazmente en un equipo remoto.
  • Portugués es un plus.
Deseable
  • Conocimientos de principios UX y capacidad para colaborar con diseñadores.
  • Experiencia frontend con frameworks modernos de JavaScript y arquitecturas basadas en componentes.
  • Experiencia con SingleStore u otras bases de datos SQL distribuidas (TiDB , CockroachDB ).
  • Experiencia desarrollando con Livewire y Alpine.js .
  • Experiencia con el panel de administración Laravel Nova .
  • Experiencia con AWS Lambda y arquitecturas serverless .
  • Integración con pasarelas de pago (Stripe, MercadoPago).
  • Experiencia en pipelines de procesamiento de contenido (PDF, EPUB, archivos de audio).
  • Familiaridad con SAML 2.0 y OAuth .
  • Experiencia con plataformas de e-commerce y facturación por suscripción .
  • Contribuciones a proyectos open source o paquetes Laravel .
Cómo trabajamos
  • Equipo 100% remoto trabajando en diferentes zonas horarias.
  • Comunicación asincrónica como estándar, con documentación clara y escrita.
  • Valoramos la calidad del código , el testing y la mantenibilidad .
  • Promovemos el aprendizaje continuo y mantenerse al día con las últimas tecnologías.
  • Fuerte enfoque en la experiencia y productividad del desarrollador .
  • Entorno colaborativo donde tu opinión importa en decisiones clave.
  • Interacción directa con clientes para comprender sus necesidades reales.
Proceso de selección
  • Conversación inicial sobre tu experiencia y objetivos profesionales.
  • Evaluación técnica enfocada en Laravel y arquitectura backend.
  • Entrevista técnica con el equipo de ingeniería para revisar tu evaluación.
  • Charla con nuestro CEO sobre la visión de la empresa y el encaje cultural.
  • Oferta.
  • Coordinación del onboarding y fecha de inicio.
Salario y beneficios
  • Salario competitivo en USD , según experiencia y ubicación.
  • Trabajo 100% remoto con horarios flexibles.
  • Estructura laboral basada en resultados .
  • Entorno de trabajo colaborativo, creativo y dinámico .
  • Oportunidad de trabajar en una plataforma líder de publicación digital .
  • Vacaciones ilimitadas.
  • Actividades de equipo ocasionales, 100% cubiertas por Publica.la.
  • Reembolso por libros adquiridos a través de nuestra plataforma.
  • Oportunidades de desarrollo profesional dentro de la empresa.
Cómo postularte

Envíanos lo siguiente:

  • Tu CV / currículum
  • Enlaces a proyectos en los que hayas trabajado (perfil de GitHub, portafolio, etc.)
  • Tus expectativas salariales
  • Una breve nota sobre por qué quieres formar parte de Publica.la

Envía tu postulación a

con el asunto: Senior Full Stack Developer (Backend Focus)

Publica.la es una plataforma SaaS B2B utilizada por cientos de editoriales, librerías y bibliotecas en todo el mundo para gestionar y potenciar sus ventas de contenido digital.

Nuestra plataforma multi-tenant procesa millones de transacciones en 156 países , administrando bibliotecas digitales, suscripciones y e-commerce a gran escala.

Buscamos un Desarrollador/a Full Stack Senior con fuerte experiencia en backend para ayudarnos a construir y escalar los sistemas centrales que impulsan este crecimiento, trabajando con Laravel/PHP , SingleStore , arquitectura multi-tenant y sistemas distribuidos .

  • Diseñar y desarrollar nuevas funcionalidades para nuestra plataforma SaaS multi-tenant, con foco en los servicios backend.

title: Pessoa Engenheira de Software Mobile - Especialista (Flutter)
description:
O que você precisa para essa posição:


Formação Acadêmica

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou experiência prática equivalente.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Atuar na construção de uma arquitetura mobile escalável e de fácil entendimento;
  • Atuar na identificação e correção de bugs e comportamentos não desejáveis;
  • Acompanhar de forma ativa a saúde das aplicações mobile utilizando-se de métricas e relatórios;
  • Colaborar de forma ativa junto às squads no planejamento, desenvolvimento e entrega de novas funcionalidades;
  • Escrever cenários de testes automatizados buscando uma cobertura de testes ampla e confiável;
  • Trabalhar de forma contínua na identificação de melhorias e otimizações de performance;
  • Zelar pela qualidade das aplicações mobile junto às lojas;
  • Zelar pela segurança das aplicações mobile.


Habilidades Técnicas:

  • Sólidos conhecimentos em desenvolvimento de aplicativos utilizando Flutter;
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de aplicativos nativos (Android com Kotlin/Java e/ou iOS com Swift/Obj-C) ;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em desenvolvimento de aplicativos utilizando gestão de estados no padrão Bloc ;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em desenvolvimento de aplicativos com Arquitetura Limpa ;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em testes unitários, integração, instrumentados e E2E ;
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de aplicativos modulares/multi-lib ;
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de design systems ;
  • Experiência com diferentes Arquiteturas e Padrões de Projetos;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos com análise e monitoramento de erros de aplicativos em produção ;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos com processo de releases nas lojas de aplicativos Google Play/Apple Store;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos com desenvolvimento e automação de esteiras de delivery .


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com frameworks e padrões de segurança, como OWASP, NIST, ISO/IEC 27001 e em programa de Security Champions.


E aí curtiu?

Inscreva-se e faça parte do nosso time!

title: Cloud Software Engineer
description:
Progress Rail is seeking a motivated and skilled Cloud Engineer to join its dynamic team. This full-time remote position reports directly to the Cloud Manager and plays a key role in designing and maintaining scalable, reliable cloud infrastructure that supports our cutting-edge rail technology solutions. The role requires independent judgment, strong problem-solving abilities, resourcefulness, and the capacity to navigate ambiguity with creativity and initiative. The ideal candidate is a self-starter with a solid background in cloud technologies, capable of balancing speed, quality, and cost-effectiveness to meet both customer and business needs.


Job Purpose:

In this role, the candidate is responsible developing & maintaining ETL/ELD ingestion, API, Web and cloud systems, that deliver real time Railroad data to customers.


About us:

As a Caterpillar company, Progress Rail is one of the largest integrated diversified providers of locomotive, freight car and infrastructure solutions and technologies for the global rail industry. Our team's deep industry expertise ensures a commitment to quality through innovative solutions.


Job Responsibilities:

  • Maintain and develop new features for Ruby on Rails web application used for software and model simulation management.
  • Maintain and enhance the ETL, web and API systems.
  • Ensure the systems are highly available, scalable, and performant.
  • Work with Amazon AWS services to deploy, monitor, and manage the systems.
  • Collaborate with other engineers to design and implement new features.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues in the production environment.
  • Optimize the performance of the systems and ensure they meet security standards.
  • Document the design, implementation, and operation of the systems.
  • Architect and maintain front end web applications.


Technical Skill

  • Experience maintaining and developing new features in Ruby on Rails web applications, particularly those used for software and model simulation management.
  • Experience in backend development with a modern programming language such as Python.
  • Proven experience with ETL systems and API microservices development.
  • Strong knowledge of AWS services and cloud architecture.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated testing.
  • Experience building and deploying high-quality front-end web applications in Angular/Vue, React.


Preferred Skills:

  • Experience with video streaming services.
  • Familiarity with container orchestration tools like Kubernetes.
  • Deep understanding of microservices architecture.
  • Experience with monitoring and logging tools.
  • Familiarity with Java SpringBoot.
  • Experience with PostgreSQL, OpenSearch, Redis, MongoDB, Docker, and Websockets.


Required Education

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related field.


Language:

Advanced English. Direct interface with global teams. Reporting to a Manager in the US.


Soft Skills:

  • Compatibility with Our Values in Action (Caterpillar Code of Conduct);
  • Autonomy : Being able to manage yourself, deal with a large number of tasks and solve minor problems proactively and responsibly.
  • Communication : Can clearly express ideas, thoughts and concepts in order to influence others or gain support.
  • Problem Solving : Able to carefully analyze situations, understand the details and root causes of problems, and resolve them independently and effectively.
  • Attention to Detail: Capable of thoroughly reviewing and interpreting facts, plans, or projects, contributing to quality assurance and impact analysis.
  • Systemic Thinking: Able to see and understand the bigger picture, identifying processes, departments, and connections, as well as how they impact the final delivery.


What we are offering for this position:

- CLT contract

- Health insurance for you and your dependents

- Dental plan for you and your dependents

- Meal vouchers

- Food voucher

- Life insurance

- Application for discounts at gyms

- Application for discounts on medicines in pharmacies

- PLR - Profit Sharing

- Private pension plan

- Continuing education allowance

- Extended maternity and paternity leave

title: Cloud Software Engineer
description:
Progress Rail is seeking a motivated and skilled Cloud Engineer to join its dynamic team. This full-time remote position reports directly to the Cloud Manager and plays a key role in designing and maintaining scalable, reliable cloud infrastructure that supports our cutting-edge rail technology solutions. The role requires independent judgment, strong problem-solving abilities, resourcefulness, and the capacity to navigate ambiguity with creativity and initiative. The ideal candidate is a self-starter with a solid background in cloud technologies, capable of balancing speed, quality, and cost-effectiveness to meet both customer and business needs.


Job Purpose:

In this role, the candidate is responsible developing & maintaining ETL/ELD ingestion, API, Web and cloud systems, that deliver real time Railroad data to customers.


About us:

As a Caterpillar company, Progress Rail is one of the largest integrated diversified providers of locomotive, freight car and infrastructure solutions and technologies for the global rail industry. Our team's deep industry expertise ensures a commitment to quality through innovative solutions.


Job Responsibilities:

  • Maintain and develop new features for Ruby on Rails web application used for software and model simulation management.
  • Maintain and enhance the ETL, web and API systems.
  • Ensure the systems are highly available, scalable, and performant.
  • Work with Amazon AWS services to deploy, monitor, and manage the systems.
  • Collaborate with other engineers to design and implement new features.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues in the production environment.
  • Optimize the performance of the systems and ensure they meet security standards.
  • Document the design, implementation, and operation of the systems.
  • Architect and maintain front end web applications.


Technical Skill

  • Experience maintaining and developing new features in Ruby on Rails web applications, particularly those used for software and model simulation management.
  • Experience in backend development with a modern programming language such as Python.
  • Proven experience with ETL systems and API microservices development.
  • Strong knowledge of AWS services and cloud architecture.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated testing.
  • Experience building and deploying high-quality front-end web applications in Angular/Vue, React.


Preferred Skills:

  • Experience with video streaming services.
  • Familiarity with container orchestration tools like Kubernetes.
  • Deep understanding of microservices architecture.
  • Experience with monitoring and logging tools.
  • Familiarity with Java SpringBoot.
  • Experience with PostgreSQL, OpenSearch, Redis, MongoDB, Docker, and Websockets.


Required Education

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related field.


Language:

Advanced English. Direct interface with global teams. Reporting to a Manager in the US.


Soft Skills:

  • Compatibility with Our Values in Action (Caterpillar Code of Conduct);
  • Autonomy : Being able to manage yourself, deal with a large number of tasks and solve minor problems proactively and responsibly.
  • Communication : Can clearly express ideas, thoughts and concepts in order to influence others or gain support.
  • Problem Solving : Able to carefully analyze situations, understand the details and root causes of problems, and resolve them independently and effectively.
  • Attention to Detail: Capable of thoroughly reviewing and interpreting facts, plans, or projects, contributing to quality assurance and impact analysis.
  • Systemic Thinking: Able to see and understand the bigger picture, identifying processes, departments, and connections, as well as how they impact the final delivery.

title: Creative Director
description:
Are you looking to work for an innovative and exciting company from Silicon Valley or New York, 100% remotely?


We are looking for multi-skilled candidates with excellent interpersonal skills for the position of Creative Director.


We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced professional who is passionate about driving creative strategies and execution across performance marketing campaigns. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in leading the creation of high-converting ad creatives, managing a creative team, and collaborating with cross-functional teams in a fast-paced, results-driven environment.


The salary range is $1,500 USD to $ 3,000 USD per month, depending on the candidate's experience and seniority.


Candidates from other Latin American countries may be considered. Candidates in a time zone outside of the western hemisphere will NOT be considered.


The role is 100% remote.


ALL RESUMES MUST BE SUBMITTED IN ENGLISH


Responsibilities:


  • Lead the creative strategy and execution for all performance marketing campaigns.
  • Write direct response sales copy for ad headlines, video scripts, graphic ads, etc.
  • Script compelling video ads optimized for platforms like YouTube, Meta, and TikTok.
  • Source, find, hire, and work with UGC creators to build an in-house UGC creation team for ad filming.
  • Use AI tools (e.g., Google VEO 3, MidJourney, ChatGPT) to create, prototype, and scale ad creatives efficiently.
  • Collaborate with media buyers, funnel strategists, UGC creators, and clients to continuously improve ad performance.
  • Provide art direction for designers and video editors; bonus points if you can edit video or graphic design yourself.
  • Manage and mentor a small creative team and UGC creators to ensure alignment with brand tone, campaign goals, and ROI targets.
  • Track performance metrics and iterate based on real-time campaign data.


Requirements:


  • 5+ years of experience in creative leadership within direct-response marketing, performance marketing, or info/lead gen businesses.
  • A killer sales copywriting portfolio showcasing a deep understanding of psychological triggers, offers, and funnel optimization.
  • Expert-level understanding of direct-response marketing principles.
  • Demonstrable skill in scripting video ads that engage and convert, and writing for UGC creators to act out your scripts.
  • Familiarity and experience using AI creative tools like Google VEO 3, MidJourney, ChatGPT, etc.
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple projects under tight deadlines.
  • Bonus: Hands-on video editing skills in tools like Adobe Premiere Pro, CapCut, or similar.


Additionally, we’ll make sure to screen for applicants who:

  • Have worked on high-ticket digital offers (webinars, call booking funnels, lead gen funnels).
  • Are familiar with platforms and tools like Hyros, ClickFunnels, and GoHigh Level.
  • Know and follow industry figures like Russell Brunson, Grant Cardone, Rudy Mawer, and Tai Lopez.
  • Can provide a portfolio that includes direct-response Facebook ad creatives (not eCommerce or branding ads).

description:
Descrição da vaga

A FCamara está em busca de uma Pessoa Desenvolvedora Back-End Java Sênior, em parceria com uma das maiores empresas de solução digital, voltada ao e-commerce que tem atuação em mais de 60 anos de história, com mais de 1.000 lojas físicas, 28 centros de distribuição e mais de 33 milhões de produtos no marketplace.

Pensando nisso, construímos a Stone Tech! A junção dos times de tecnologia Stone Co. e as empresas financeiras do grupo que reconhecem o potencial empreendedor de cada brasileiro. Por aqui, temos todas as inovações e tecnologias de ponta da Stone, Pagar.me, Ton e Vitta, com uma galera referência no mercado de tecnologia, em um ambiente descontraído, repleto de desafios, oportunidades, flexibilidade, teamplay e desenvolvimento contínuo.

Nossa cultura:

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

⚡Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

title: Search Engine Optimization Specialist
description:
SEO Specialist

Remote : Latin America

Rate : USD $8-12/hr

Contract Role


SEO/TECHNICAL SKILLS

  • SEO migration - redirection mapping and implementation
  • Knowledge of technical SEO components (canonicalization, XML sitemaps, keyword cannibalization, robots.txt, schema), investigating indexation and crawl errors , conducting site audits
  • Familiarity and applied experience with tools such as Screaming Frog, Google Search Console, SEMRush (other SEO tools like Ahrefs or Moz) and Google Analytics
  • Strong understanding of core SEO concepts such as crawlability, renderability, and indexability, links, keyword research and content

LOCAL SEO:

Google Business profile optimization

Experience in hyperlocal SEO, including location business listing management across online directories

EXPERIENCE:

SEO migrations

Experience doing technical SEO at scale

Experience working with (and analyzing) large amounts of data

Spreadsheets

Collaboration

Pro-active problem solving

Attention to detail

Accountability

Self-motivated

title: Closer Digital
description:
VAGA ABERTA: CLOSER DIGITAL – ALTA PERFORMANCE EM VENDAS



Você é fera em fechar vendas, domina conversas estratégicas e busca crescimento acelerado no mercado digital?

A RedSuit quer você no time! Procuramos Closers que transformam oportunidades em vendas de alto valor, com performance acima da média e sede por resultados.


O que é um Closer Digital?

O Closer Digital atua na última etapa do funil de vendas, recebendo leads já qualificados por Social Sellers, marketing e tráfego pago.

Seu foco é converter esses leads em clientes, conduzindo calls estratégicas via Google Meet, aplicando técnicas de venda consultiva, lidando com objeções e levando o cliente ao "sim".

Sem prospecção ativa ou criação de conteúdo – você foca 100% no fechamento.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Conduzir chamadas de vendas via Google Meet com leads qualificados
  • Diagnosticar dores e necessidades reais do cliente
  • Apresentar a proposta de forma clara, estratégica e persuasiva
  • Fechar vendas de produtos digitais de alto valor (mentorias, consultorias, cursos)
  • Realizar follow-ups inteligentes para aumentar conversão
  • Atualizar e gerenciar o CRM (Kommo) com consistência
  • Participar de reuniões semanais com o time comercial e marketing
  • O que esperamos de vocêExperiência comprovada como Closer ou em vendas consultivas digitais
  • Comunicação de alto nível, escuta ativa e foco em solução
  • Disciplina para cumprir metas e manter rotina de fechamento
  • Conhecimento em funis de vendas, CRM e gestão de leads
  • Estrutura para trabalho remoto (PC/Laptop + celular)
  • Perfil movido por resultados, aprendizado contínuo e crescimento


O que oferecemos:

  • Fixo base + comissões agressivas (OTE: R$5.000 a R$10.000/mês, ganhos escaláveis)
  • Mentoria e treinamentos exclusivos
  • Trabalho 100% remoto, com flexibilidade de horário
  • Contrato PJ
  • Oportunidade de crescer junto a grandes projetos do mercado digital


Nossa Cultura

Na RedSuit, alta performance é padrão. Valorizamos aprendizado contínuo, ambiente leve e colaborativo e a busca incessante por resultados reais para nossos clientes.

Aqui, cada venda é uma transformação na vida de quem confia no nosso trabalho.

title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
About the company:

Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.

Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.


About the opportunity:

We are seeking a motivated DevOps Engineer to support our cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines in a dynamic

environment leveraging Kubernetes, AWS, GCP, Postgres, and Terraform. In this role, you will participate in automating

infrastructure provisioning, managing containerized applications,and maintaining CI/CD workflows to ensure smooth and

scalable deployments. You will work closely with senior engineers to troubleshoot issues, implement best practices, and

enhance system reliability and performance across multi-cloud platforms. This is an excellent opportunity to grow your skills in a

fast-paced, collaborative DevOps environment.


work MST or PST hours.



What you get to do every day:

-Participate in an on-call rotation on a regular basis and respond to incidents reliably and professionally.

-Maintain and evolve our AWS cloud infrastructure, employing automation, and infrastructure-as-code using Terraform.

-Build and maintain our code pipelines, designing and building automation in order to enable agile software development, using self-service where possible.

-Collaborate efficiently and effectively with other team members and Software Engineers to solve complex problems.

-Quickly absorb context and knowledge while ramping up.


✅Skills/Experience:

Minimum Requirements:

-4-6 years experience in SRE, DevOps, or similar role

-Experience with cloud provider platforms such as AWS or GCP

-Experience with relational databases (e.g., Postgres, MySQL)

-Familiarity with Kubernetes

- Experience with GitOps CI/CD tools (e.g., Harness, Argo, Flux,Jenkins)

- Familiarity with declarative infrastructure-as-code tools (e.g.,Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi)

-Exposure to logging, monitoring, metrics collection, and observability tools (e.g., DataDog, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack, CloudWatch)



✨Desired Skills (Nice to Haves):

- Experience with software development and automation in

languages beyond shell scripting (e.g., golang, python, elixir,java, etc.)

- Experience with platform development of tools for development, staging, and integration environments

- Experience with debugging performance or networking issues in applications running on Kubernetes

- Experience with audit compliance (e.g., SOX, SOC2, ISO27001, PCI DSS)

- Working knowledge of UNIX-based Operating Systems

-Computer Science or Engineering degree



Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: Ruby on Rails Developer
description:
About You

You are a back-end engineer passionate about building scalable, reliable, and maintainable applications. You thrive on writing clean code, applying modern architecture patterns, and leveraging cloud-based solutions. You enjoy solving complex challenges, automating infrastructure, and ensuring that systems are secure, performant, and ready to scale. You’re looking for a company where you can keep growing professionally and directly influence technical excellence.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field; or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in back-end development using Ruby on Rails.
  • Strong experience with AWS services such as Lambda, EC2, S3, RDS, and API Gateway.
  • Hands-on experience using Terraform for Infrastructure as Code (IaC) deployments.
  • Solid understanding of serverless architectures and AWS Lambda functions.
  • Experience designing and consuming RESTful and GraphQL APIs.
  • Knowledge of PostgreSQL, Redis, and background job frameworks (Sidekiq, Resque).
  • Familiarity with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and automated deployments.
  • Experience working with Agile/Scrum methodologies, and proficiency using Jira and Confluence for project tracking.
  • Strong debugging, problem-solving, and communication skills for cross-functional collaboration.
  • Experience with microservices, GoLang, or Node.js for complementary service integration (nice to have).


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain Ruby on Rails applications with a focus on scalability and performance.
  • Build and manage AWS infrastructure components using Terraform and DevOps best practices.
  • Implement and maintain serverless solutions leveraging AWS Lambda and related services.
  • Integrate and maintain APIs and external systems, ensuring reliability and data consistency.
  • Refactor legacy components to improve maintainability, performance, and code clarity.
  • Write and maintain automated tests (RSpec, Minitest) to ensure high code quality and coverage.
  • Monitor application performance and proactively address issues or bottlenecks.
  • Collaborate on CI/CD pipelines, ensuring secure, consistent, and efficient deployments.
  • Participate in code reviews, maintaining high-quality development standards.
  • Engage in Agile ceremonies (standups, sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives).
  • Work closely with front-end, DevOps, and QA teams to deliver robust, end-to-end solutions.


Additional Information

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.

  • Special discounts*
  • Entertainment area*
  • Modern Work Spaces*
  • Great work environment

title: Instructional Designer
description:
Instructional Designer

Remote – Brazil | Contract | Full-Time


About the Role

Our client is looking for an Instructional Designer responsible for designing, developing, and delivering high-quality learning materials to support internal teams and partners. The focus will be on creating scalable, engaging learning experiences for product readiness, systems/process training, and ongoing enablement programs.

This role requires a self-sufficient professional with strong creative design capabilities and advanced proficiency in Articulate Storyline. The ideal candidate can quickly adapt, work independently, and collaborate effectively with subject matter experts and cross-functional stakeholders.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop e-learning modules, videos, and other instructional content using Articulate Storyline and multimedia tools.
  • Manage multiple training projects, including systems/process training and product or solution readiness.
  • Collaborate with SMEs and internal teams to ensure content accuracy and alignment with business objectives.
  • Apply instructional design methodologies to ensure engaging and measurable learning outcomes.
  • Define content strategy and deliver final assets for publishing.
  • Track learner engagement and performance, using analytics and feedback to improve materials.
  • Stay up to date with instructional design trends and emerging technologies.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Instructional Design, Education, Communications, or related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in instructional design or enablement, preferably in complex or technical environments.
  • Advanced proficiency in Articulate Storyline (must be able to start with minimal onboarding).
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills.
  • Strong creative and visual design abilities to translate complex topics into clear, learner-centered content.
  • Experience developing learning materials for internal teams, sales enablement, or process training initiatives.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with Learning Management Systems (LMS) and features such as branching, gamification, and assessments.
  • Certification in Instructional Design or Sales Enablement .

title: Analista de Dados Especialista (DA) # 976069'
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Nosso Cliente

Esta vaga irá atender nosso cliente no segmento da tecnologia.

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Coletar e interpretar dados do estado bruto para insights;
  • Criar soluções (dashboards, papers, insights);
  • Atuar como ponte principal entre as equipes de dados técnicos e os requisitos de dados de negócio;
  • Análises exploratórias, descritivas e preditivas end-to-end;
  • Desenvolvimento de soluções de Self-Service de dados;
  • Suporte à tomada de decisão das áreas de negócio;
  • Ser ponto de contato (BP) com times de negócio, squads e/ou liderança;
  • Identificação de oportunidades de projetos;
  • Desenvolvimento do time de dados;
  • Desenvolvimento de projetos internos.

O que você precisa ter

  • Estatística: Análise Descritiva, probabilidade, inferência, bootstrapping, testes de hipótese, regressão, modelagem e métodos quantitativos;
  • Data Visualization: Drill down e Roll up, slice & dice, LOD;
  • Storytelling: Frameworks de análise, sumarização de problemas, use cases, personas;
  • Lógica de Programação: Escrever e revisar queries em banco de dados, usar parâmetros, criar variáveis;
  • Business-driven: Conhecer o dia a dia de áreas de negócio, métricas de mercado, processos e necessidades. Pensar na solução antes da execução técnica;
  • Comunicação: Ser interface com stakeholders e múltiplas áreas. Mapear necessidades de curto, médio e longo prazos. Comunicação clara para guiar equipes internas e externas;
  • Power BI;
  • Modelagem de Dados (Star Schema, SnowFlake, modelo de Fato e Dimensão);
  • SQL;
  • Arquitetura Medalhão (Lakehouse/Data Lake);
  • Business Analytics/Insights.

Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

Regime de Contratação

CLT

Será um destaque seu perfil com:

Scala (Desejável);

Spark/PySpark(Desejável);

Tableau (disposição para aprender caso não saiba) (Desejável).
